title: Tundra
author: David Dyte
description:
Note: this game is unfinished and abandoned. See the README file in the ZIP. Recovered by Torbjörn Andersson in 2021.

It is dark and silent for a long time. But as the day grows colder coming into the evening, you wake to find yourself alone and abandoned, tent and firewood a distant memory. Is this your friends' idea of a practical joke?
